cohort: 559 patients who had a computer tomography pelvimetry prior to delivery of a term breech presentation
finding: In the asymmetric pelvis group, the vaginal delivery rate was higher (93% versus 78%, p = 0.05).
mod_finding: The vaginal delivery rate was higher in women with a difference of ≥ 1 cm between the lengths of both oblique diameters (asymmetric pelvis) compared to those with a difference of < 1 cm (symmetric pelvis).
